verdict.rationale: Orb's own docs show that ops users can apply or edit discounts on individual subscriptions, from the UI or the API. That covers only the coupon-like slice of this story. Nothing in the pack covers free trials, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, promotion codes, or trial-end notifications for card-network compliance. missing for 10: free trial configuration, automatic trial-to-paid conversion, promotion/redeemable codes, trial-end notifications meeting card-network rules, independent corroboration of discount handling

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules

citations.quote: apply or edit discounts, maximums, minimums, and schedule effective dates - without changing the plan itself
